capabilities: Render hexagram diagrams from a 6-digit liuyao code block
Accept an optional date line to show the six gods
Look up hexagram family and name, including 6-trigram-name input
Show a copyright watermark with version, year and author on each card
extras: Rendered cards always include a copyright watermark (version, year, author Kasukabe Tsumugi); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display Liuyao (I Ching) hexagram diagrams from plain text input.
summary: Renders Liuyao six-line divination hexagram diagrams in notes from fenced liuyao code blocks.
